svg.text: REV L1 - running gear per owner plan LT18-LT20 (to LT42):
8 drivers Ø1,450 (spoked look), 2 powered trucks, 1,550 wb,
pivots X4075/7275, axles X3300/4850/6500/8050; inside frames.
Leading truck Ø650, X1000/2050, swing arm to X2600. No trailer.
Main rails Y±240 Z1150-1455; running board Z1,605 (155 over drivers).
REV L4 drive: 4x Poclain MS05 468/234 2-speed + T04, frame-mounted,
ANSI 120-2 15T:45T 3:1 chain in oil bath, Ø150 pressed hub (L-103.2).
NOTHING outside the wheels; frame between the wheels.
2% start 37.67 kN @350 bar vs 32.61 (NO divider; equal torque dry/sanded 1.14,
1.146 with truck-pitch transfer, low traction pin h 0.65). Wet: sand MANDATORY.
GOVERNED 6 mph (42 cc stop + sealed 2,600 rpm: 5.96 mph); indep. 7 mph trip.
Brakes: axle disc + 2 spring calipers per powered axle (Y+); MS05 T04 park.
Ballast: 151 kg front pockets + NB-1 59.8 kg nose (X450); pony 1.25 t.
Max driver wheel 25.89 kN <= 26. Decor. cylinders Y±790.
Roof 3,700 ADOPTED. Cab floor 1,605, headroom ~2,010 w/ mat.
PULSIPHER FARMS · LOGANDALE, NEVADA · CHRISTMAS TRAIN (PF-CT)
Units mm unless noted · Z above top of rail · gauge 914.4 · 3rd-angle
Machined: Ra 3.2 · bores H7/H8 as noted · break edges
GD&T ASME Y14.5-2018 · welds AWS A2.4 / D1.1
